settings.title: SpaNET Settings
settings.description: Pump type is detected automatically. Choose a mode for each pump only if you want to override the detected controls. Original pump switches and automations are preserved.

confirm_two_speed.title: Confirm unverified two-speed controls
confirm_two_speed.description: SpaNET reports a single-speed pump for: {pumps}. Enabling two-speed commands on unverified hardware may behave unexpectedly or operate the pump incorrectly. Only proceed if you have physically verified the pump supports two speeds and can supervise a test.

data.acknowledge_unverified: I have verified this hardware supports two-speed operation and accept the risk

error.unsupported_pump: This controller reports an unsupported or non-controllable pump. Two-speed controls were not enabled.
error.confirmation_required: Please confirm the hardware is two-speed before enabling its controls.
